name: ai-english-companion
description: Technical spike for a macOS AI English companion

scripts.test:recovery: npm run build:main && node --test dist-electron/aiRecovery.test.js dist-electron/recoveryLifecycle.test.js
scripts.spike:selection: mkdir -p dist-native && xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -Wall -Wextra -mmacosx-version-min=14.0 native/SelectionProbe.m -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -o dist-native/selection-probe && dist-native/selection-probe
scripts.build:selection-action: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && mkdir -p dist-native && xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -Wall -Wextra -mmacosx-version-min=14.0 native/SelectionProbe.m -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -o dist-native/selection-probe
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p dist-native && xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -mmacosx-version-min=14.0 native/FrontmostApp.m -framework AppKit -o dist-native/frontmost-app && xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -mmacosx-version-min=14.0 native/GlobalMouseMonitor.m -framework ApplicationServices -o dist-native/global-mouse-monitor && xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -Wall -Wextra -mmacosx-version-min=14.0 native/SelectionProbe.m -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -o dist-native/selection-probe
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:native
